summary:
Starventures is an interactive space mission design game that turns complex NASA engineering challenges into an engaging, hands-on experience.

The game will present 10 space missions inspired directly by NASAs successful mission. The first one is inspired by the Apollo 15 mission, our game allows players to experience three essential stages of space mission preparation: building a spacecraft, selecting and training astronauts, and managing resources. Players make decisions using a limited currency called Stardust, balancing scientific goals, costs, safety, and efficiency.

What separates us for our competition is the unexpected. Space exploration rarely goes according to plan! Throughout the game, players encounter emergencies, from equipment failures to crew conflicts, and must find creative, scientifically accurate solutions. The game also incorporates real NASA data, orbital physics, and interactive satellite deployment.

Unlike traditional learning methods, Starventure allows players to experiment, make mistakes, and understand the consequences of their decisions. At the end, they receive a personalized mission report highlighting their strengths, weaknesses, and relevant NASA educational resources.

Our goal is to make space engineering accessible, exciting, and understandable while encouraging critical thinking, problem-solving, and curiosity about space exploration.
details:
Designing and participating in a space mission is a incredibly exclusivist domain in modern times. Starventures was designed to solve this exact problem, by introducing inexperienced individuals to the world of dealing with the tasks of planning a mission: selecting rocket components, carefully choosing and testing your crew, managing resources, and many other levels that are planned in the future. Starventures is a interactive game that guides you through all these tasks.

The project was written in Python, JavaScript and HTML, with the polish of SI (Codex). It is uploaded online on a website (https://starventures.anaspinu.ro/).

In comparison to our competitors, we implement a lot of challenges throughout the game that help develop critical thinking, through activities like balancing the need of good equipment with the need not to exceed the maximum mass of the rocket, etc.

We are proud to have managed to maintain an equilibrium between keeping the attention of the user and offering him a new educational experience.
